card.line: Tarshish was a far-off place across the sea, known for ships bringing riches to Solomon, and the place Jonah tried to sail to when he fled from God.

moments.title: Solomon's ships of Tarshish
moments.text: King Solomon had ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram's fleet. Once every three years they arrived bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

moments.title: Jehoshaphat's ships wrecked
moments.text: Jehoshaphat and Ahaziah agreed to build ships to go to Tarshish at Ezion-geber. Eliezer prophesied against Jehoshaphat, and the ships were wrecked and could not sail.

moments.title: Jonah flees toward Tarshish
moments.text: God told Jonah to go to Nineveh. Instead Jonah went to Joppa, paid the fare on a ship bound for Tarshish, and sailed away from the presence of the LORD.

moments.title: Why Jonah ran
moments.text: After Nineveh turned from its evil, Jonah was angry. He prayed that he had fled toward Tarshish because he knew God is gracious, compassionate, and slow to anger.
